title: Polynomial-Time Prefix Removal
statement: For a bit string $z$, decode its pair, take the second component (or the empty string if decoding fails), and remove from its beginning as many bits as the length of the first component (or zero if decoding fails). The resulting function on bit strings is computable by a deterministic finite-state Turing machine in time $C(n+1)^c$ on every input of length $n$, for some natural numbers $C$ and $c$.
